items.front: Who created the HDI and in which year's report?
items.back: Mahbub-ul-Haq with Amartya Sen; first UNDP HDR in 1990.
items.examPoint: HDI origin — Haq & Sen, HDR 1990

items.front: Three dimensions of the HDI?
items.back: Health (life expectancy), knowledge (schooling), living standard (GNI per capita PPP).
items.examPoint: HDI three dimensions

items.front: How is HDI aggregated since HDR 2010?
items.back: Geometric mean of the three equally weighted sub-indices.
items.examPoint: HDI = geometric mean (since 2010)

items.front: India's rank and HDI value in HDR 2025?
items.back: 130/193, HDI 0.685 — Medium Human Development (up from 134).
items.source: Wikipedia — List of countries by HDI (verified 30 Sep 2026)

items.front: HDI category bands?
items.examPoint: HDI category bands

items.front: Global MPI — agencies, method and formula?
items.back: UNDP + OPHI; Alkire-Foster method; MPI = H × A (headcount × intensity).
items.examPoint: Global MPI — UNDP/OPHI, MPI=H×A

items.front: How does India's National MPI differ from Global MPI?
items.back: 3 dimensions but 12 indicators (adds maternal health & bank accounts); by NITI Aayog.
items.examPoint: National MPI — 12 indicators (NITI Aayog)

items.front: Which report defined sustainable development, and when?
items.back: Brundtland Report 'Our Common Future', 1987 — intergenerational equity.
items.examPoint: Brundtland 1987 defined sustainable development

items.front: SDGs — number of goals/targets and adoption year?
items.back: 17 goals, 169 targets; adopted Sep 2015 (2030 Agenda); succeeded 8 MDGs.
items.examPoint: SDGs — 17 goals, 169 targets, 2015

items.front: Milestone sequence of sustainable development?
items.back: Stockholm 1972 → Brundtland 1987 → Rio 1992 → MDGs 2000 → SDGs 2015.
items.examPoint: Sustainable-development milestones

items.front: SDG India Index — publisher and score bands?
items.back: NITI Aayog; Aspirant 0-49, Performer 50-64, Front Runner 65-99, Achiever 100.
items.examPoint: SDG India Index — NITI Aayog, bands

items.front: AP's standout SDG India Index performance?
items.back: Front Runner; topped Goal-7 (Affordable & Clean Energy) among States.
items.examPoint: AP SDG Index — Front Runner, tops Goal-7

items.front: Companion measures to HDI?
items.back: IHDI (inequality-adjusted), GDI (female/male ratio), GII (gender inequality).
items.examPoint: HDI companions — IHDI, GDI, GII

items.front: Range of HDI values?
items.back: The HDI always lies between 0 and 1 (geometric mean of three dimension indices).
items.examPoint: HDI — concept, creators (Mahbub-ul-Haq & Amartya Sen) and first HDR (1990)

items.front: Expand AHDI and name the other three indices listed with it.
items.back: AHDI = Augmented Human Development Index; listed with HDI, IHDI (inequality-adjusted) and GDI (gender development).
